entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered when UE performs de-registration, registration request is rejected, service request is rejected, UE is switched on, or emergency registered UE's periodic registration timer expires.

entities.name: De-registration
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE or network that leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: Registration request
entities.description: Message sent by UE that can be rejected by AMF, leading to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: Service request
entities.description: Message sent by UE that can be rejected by AMF, leading to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE switched on
entities.description: Condition where UE is powered on, leading to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: Emergency periodic registration timer expires
entities.description: Condition where UE registered for emergency services in 5GMM-IDLE mode has periodic registration update timer expire.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: State where UE is not actively communicating with network.

relations.description: Rejection of registration request by AMF leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Rejection of service request by AMF leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE being switched on leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Emergency periodic registration timer expiration leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Emergency periodic registration timer expiration condition requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE state.
